# "org" ensures this Service is used with the correct Serverless Framework Access Key.
org: minnalnh
# "service" is the name of this project. This will also be added to your AWS resource names.
service: hp-api

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs24.x
  architecture: arm64
  region: eu-north-1
  iam:
    role: arn:aws:iam::816435462993:role/BasicLambdaAccess

functions:
  ## CHARACTERS
  getCharacters:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /characters
          method: get
  getCharacterById:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /characters/{id}
          method: get
  createCharacter:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /characters
          method: post
  updateCharacters:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /characters/{id}
          method: put
  deleteCharacter:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /characters/{id}
          method: delete

  ## HOUSES
  getHouses:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /houses
          method: get
  getHouseById:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /houses/{id}
          method: get

  ## SPELLS
  getSpells:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /spells
          method: get
  getSpellById:
    handler: functions/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /spells/{id}
          method: get
  auth:
    handler: functions/auth/login/index.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
        path: /auth/login
        method: post
